verdict.rationale: Base44 is an AI-powered app builder, so a training opt-out or data-use policy is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains nothing on a training opt-out, data-use policy, or privacy controls covering model training. The security-vulnerability items are about auth flaws, not training data use, so they are irrelevant to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
